history.summary: 99yr 2017 1BR directly beside Tanah Merah MRT (D16, OCR/RCR border). Asking $1,328 PSF is below eCO's 12-month transaction range of $1,379-$1,770 PSF (avg ~$1,557) — and 1BRs normally trade at a PSF premium to the large-unit-heavy average, so this is genuinely cheap. Supported by deep data (191 appreciation txns, 20-unit cohort).
history.rating_rationale: The algo's -24.4% age-adj and -9.3% cohort cheapness is corroborated: eCO's recorded 12-month range is $1,379-$1,770 PSF (avg ~$1,505-1,557), so this 689 sqft 1BR at $1,328 PSF is below the entire range, and since small units usually price ABOVE the blended average, the discount is real rather than a size-mix artifact. Crucially, the signal sits on 191 appreciation transactions and a 20-unit cohort — deep enough to trust, unlike the thin-cohort names in this batch. Location is a standout: directly beside Tanah Merah MRT (East-West Line, interchange to Changi/Expo branch), in a large 748-unit project with strong liquidity (30 profitable resales in the past year). OCR-belt forward prior is favourable. Confidence is medium rather than high because I could not pin an exact same-size 1BR comparable, but the project-level evidence is consistent.
red_flags: No exact same-size 1BR transaction isolated; discount inferred from project-wide range plus size-PSF logic
99yr leasehold (2012 commencement) so lease decay clock is running
catalysts: Directly beside Tanah Merah MRT (East-West Line interchange) — top-tier connectivity for the east
Large 748-unit development with deep resale/rental liquidity and consistent profitable exits

history.summary: Sound asset at a full price: a SOHO/loft-format 3BR at eCO with great Tanah Merah connectivity and deep project liquidity, asking at the format's recent PSF peak with a structurally low ~3.2% yield. Good location does not equal good entry here.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,788,000 / $1,748 psf matches the format's recent high ($1,770 psf same-size print, Apr 2026), leaving no value cushion — the opposite of prior eCO Buys, which were units genuinely below the project range. Under current priors, value is the strongest forward signal and this is fully priced, not cheap (+6.8% vs the 800-1050 band median, partly format mix). The 1,023 sqft 'compact 3BR' is a double-volume SOHO/loft: its high PSF is paid in ceiling-height/void, but rent earns only apartment-level dollars, so gross yield is a thin ~3.2% — weak carry for a 5-7yr hold, and a narrower exit buyer pool than a conventional flat 3BR. Offsetting positives are real but not enough to lift it to Buy: OCR/RCR-border East Coast region (best realized forward region signal), doorstep Tanah Merah EWL/Changi interchange (~5-7 min walk), 748-unit liquidity, and 87yr lease. Trailing 3.89% CAGR is not credited (≈0 forward power). Net: a good development at a price that gives the buyer no edge.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Est. ~$4,800/mo → ~3.2% gross yield. Low and structural to the format; even at a generous $5,200 it is ~3.5%. Treat as carry only, not appreciation.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Region (OCR east) and liquidity are tailwinds, but entry at the format's PSF peak removes the value edge that drives forward returns. Do not credit the 3.89% trailing CAGR. Net expectation: market-typical, not outperformance.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: No researched eCO profile. Format inferred (SOHO/Loft 3BR compact). Confirm before committing: (1) exact floor and facing, (2) whether SOHO or true Loft, (3) ceiling height / usable layout, (4) condition. A high floor with unblocked/north-south facing would justify the full ask better.
